items.title: The comparison between the Zariski topoi of the big and small sites of a locally quasi-compact space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects the comparison results between the Zariski topoi of the big site of locally quasi-compact spaces and the small Zariski topoi of a space, in seven numbered items covering cohomology, exactness of the pushforward, the unit of the adjunction, the derived statement, the commutativity of the square induced by a morphism f : X -> Y, and the base change identities for a proper f (statement lines 7769-7804). Each item is proved separately in the counted span: parts (1)-(3) are read off from the comparison of a site with a bigger site and from the identity of the composite tau_X^{-1} pi_X^{-1} (proof lines 7806-7826), part (5) is built from the relocalization result (proof lines 7832-7839), part (6) combines the computation of cohomology on open subschemes with the previous parts (proof lines 7842-7851), and parts (7a) and (7b) compare both sides on sections over an object of LC_Zar/Y using the fibred square, the derived case being handled through the presheaf description of the higher direct images (proof lines 7854-7915). The claim is H2: seven short arguments of the same flavour, each written out, with the derived case as the most technical.
